category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-1 (Information Security and Privacy Program Plan), CA-2(2) (Specialized Assessments)
implementation_examples: Improve protection processes through root-cause analysis of incidents, control-assessment findings, and external-research inputs
Use a defined improvement methodology (e.g., plan-do-check-act) with measurable outcomes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether protection processes are improved through root-cause analysis
Determine whether a documented improvement methodology is used
Determine whether improvement outcomes are measurable
Determine whether improvements are reported to leadership
